sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2.  The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant with a prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No. 0004 of 2024, registered under Sections 498A, 304B, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C.
and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station Jamania, District Ghazipur during pendency of the trial.

3. Prosecution story is that informant's daughter was married with applicant's son five years back and accused persons committed maar peet for additional demand of dowry and when demand of dowry was not fulfilled, the accused persons assaulted her.
Deceased was pregnant of seven months and jumped in front of train for committing suicide.

Ramashish vs State Of U.P. on 9 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/135728783/
1 4.
Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case due to ulterior motive.
Applicant is father-in-law of the deceased and allegation of demand of dowry is totally false and baseless.
As per post mortem report, cause of death is instantaneous death as a result of ante mortem crushed injuries.
Deceased was in depression for not getting her ancestral property from her step mother, as such, she went under depression and committed suicide.
Applicant has been implicated being father-in-law of the deceased.
Applicant has no previous criminal history.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 05.01.2024.
In case, the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and co-operate in trial.
5. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the bail prayer of the applicant.

6. Considering the material available on record and keeping in view the nature of the offence,
argument advanced on behalf of the parties, evidence on record regarding complicity of the accused and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.
The bail application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant, Ramashish, who is involved in the aforesaid case crime, be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
Further, before issuing the release order, the sureties be verified.
i. The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/ pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.
ii. The applicant shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
iii. The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
8. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.

Order Date :- 9.7.2024 Nitin Verma  Ramashish vs State Of U.P. on 9 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/135728783/
